features.label: Main clubhouse roof
features.notes: Visible main roof perimeter, including intersecting north and east wings. Dark grey roof. Eaves and roof displacement are not wall-footprint measurements; heights and pitch unresolved. IMPORTANT: the east entrance porch projects into roof shadow and is omitted from this main-roof ring because its outer edge cannot be confidently isolated. Add that porch as a separate photo-corroborated component; the yellow existing-model east bump is context only. R02 is the separate west terrace-side porch, not the eastern entrance.
unresolvedComponents: east entrance porch roof edge and wall footprint

features.label: Clubhouse west attached porch roof
features.notes: Small attached west-facing roof by terrace; exact function and wall base unknown.

features.label: Eastern campus accommodation block candidate
features.notes: Northernmost of three smaller connected dark-roof blocks south of clubhouse. Photo/site evidence needed to assign hotel room wings definitively.

features.label: Middle campus accommodation block candidate
features.notes: Middle dark-roof block with small connection at southwest edge. Roof-edge ring includes connection visible from above.

features.label: Southern campus accommodation block candidate
features.notes: Southern block west of pool; roof includes visible lower west annex. Pool-side function must be matched against exterior photos.

features.label: Translucent rectangular roof east of middle block
features.notes: Light/translucent roof with cross ribs. Could be enclosure or conservatory; orthophoto alone does not identify function.

features.label: Small polygonal garden roof
features.notes: Small polygonal gazebo-like roof east of pool. Tree/shadow overlap limits exact corner count.

features.label: Long roof immediately west of padel court
features.notes: Clearly visible substantial dark roof absent from current infrastructure model. Do not assign hotel, maintenance or padel use from proximity alone.

features.label: Visible clubhouse west dining terrace
features.notes: Approximate visible paved dining/terrace area around tables and passage. Shadows, furniture and planting obscure the full perimeter; ground-level photo required.

features.label: Outdoor pool water surface
features.notes: Pool water edge only, excluding white deck/surround and steps; permanent pool dimension is approximate.

features.label: Blue outdoor padel playing enclosure
features.notes: Visible blue playing enclosure, excluding cast fence shadows and surrounding paths. Fence/glass height not determined.

features.label: Northwest campus parking apron
features.notes: Gravel/asphalt parking apron inferred from visible material boundary; cars and vegetation obscure edges.

features.label: Central north-south parking apron
features.notes: Parking strip east of clubhouse and west of planted divider. Material edge approximate under parked cars.

features.label: Eastern parking apron
features.notes: Eastern parking strip and southern turning connection. Far eastern bays partially limited by panel edge.

features.label: Clubhouse entrance circular island
features.notes: Oval/circular paved or planted entrance feature in front of clubhouse. Interior sculpture/flag/details require exterior references.

features.label: Range-end covered building
features.notes: Dark roof at northeast end of curved range mat line. Open bay count and support structure require frontal photos.

features.label: Curved range hitting-mat apron
features.notes: Visible paved curved mat apron excluding roofed range-end building. Mat positions and flagpoles should be added individually from this native panel; do not infer count from shadows.

features.label: Western complex long L-shaped roof
features.notes: Three-building complex west of main campus. Appears service-related from yard access, but function and ownership unconfirmed. Large north/east roof shadow excluded.

features.label: Western complex eastern rectangular roof
features.notes: North-south rectangular grey roof in western yard; roof fixtures visible. Function and height unknown.

features.label: Western complex southern rectangular roof
features.notes: Short east-west rectangular roof south of western complex. Function and height unknown.

features.label: Northern neighboring building west of road
features.notes: Visible elongated roof is substantially displaced/rotated relative to old synthetic gravel-yard-hall-A rectangle. Treat as neighboring context; golf ownership/use unverified.

features.label: Northern neighboring southern building west of road
features.notes: Long narrow grey roof adjacent to bright white terrace/roof complex. The old gravel-yard-hall-B polygon does not describe this roof. Ownership and golf use unverified.

features.label: Northern neighboring upper house east of road
features.notes: Complex dark roof east of road beside private-looking pool/deck. No golf-facility identity inferred.

features.label: Northern neighboring lower house east of road
features.notes: Complex pitched roof and landscaping visible east of road; no golf ownership/use established.

features.label: Small northern neighboring pool-side roof
features.notes: Small roof beside northern neighboring house and pool. Included solely as surrounding visual context.
